why: PF 1.0.40 ships the two release stages and their styles (G278 / 1506). These are COPIES, pinned so the controls that prove core still serves them run in CI, where the private sibling repo is not checked out. They are not in fixtures/shared-sugar because that mechanism's drift guard fails on a file absent from the sibling WORKING TREE, and these live on a branch. test_g268_retired_stage_names.py compares them to the live files whenever those are reachable.
